title: Objective O1 Block Schema
description: JSON Schema contract for ObjectiveBlock version O1 (Simple Learning Goals / Skills You Will Develop).

eyebrow.description: Uppercase category badge text displayed above the block title.

title.description: Main heading for the Objective O1 block.
title.default: Skills You Will Develop in This Lesson

titleHighlight.description: Optional substring within title to highlight with the primary brand color.

introduction.description: Lead paragraph introducing the learning goals.

objectives.description: Collection of observable learning goals and practical skills.

verb.description: Action verb emphasized at the start of the skill title (e.g., Create, Access, Extract, Modify, Use, Explain).

title.description: Short skill heading (e.g., 'Create and initialize lists').

text.description: Observable learning goal statement or detailed skill description.

description.description: Optional detailed explanation under the skill heading.

badge.description: Skill category pill label (e.g., 'Practical Skill', 'Core Skill', 'Understanding').
